reason: BLOCKED: Antigravity 2.0.6 (Antigravity.exe FileVersion 2.0.6, %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Antigravity) is present on the build machine, but it is a GUI IDE and no headless agent entry point exists to drive it from a script: `resources\bin\language_server.exe` is only the IDE's language server, and `~\.gemini\antigravity\bin\agentapi.bat` (language_server.exe agentapi) exits with {"error": "ANTIGRAVITY_LS_ADDRESS is not set"} because it needs the address of a language server started by a signed-in IDE window. No hook run was observed. The only corroboration is that the installed language_server.exe contains the strings `hooks.json`, `No hooks.json found at %s`, `PreToolUse` and `PreInvocation`; that is not verification of payloads, tool names or output bytes. The 03 section 16 mapping and hook-output rows for `antigravity` stay docs-derived.
needs: Either (a) a headless Antigravity CLI/SDK that runs an agent turn from a script, or (b) GUI automation of the signed-in IDE (computer-use) running a session in a scratch folder with `.agents/hooks.json` configured for PreInvocation, PreToolUse, PostToolUse and Stop. The Google account used by the IDE must stay signed in.
